How many tennis balls did Rory retrieve in the first set of the match? Rory retrieved tennis balls from the court after a tennis match. In the first of three sets, Rory retrieved four more tennis balls than in the second set. In the third set, Rory retrieved half as many tennis balls as in the second set.
